title: Modular A/V: Audio mixer
shortDesc: A mixer for your voice: which effects run, in which order, and how loud. Holds no effects itself: it mixes the effect modules a world has turned on. A GM can lay a preset over the whole table, or one player.

title: Modular A/V: Krisp for LiveKit Cloud
shortDesc: Adds LiveKit's Krisp noise filter to the noise cancellation choice when your table calls through LiveKit Cloud. Players' browsers download it from npm (jsDelivr) when they turn it on, and Krisp reports the room's name and id, the player's user id and…
description: Adds LiveKit's Krisp noise filter to the noise cancellation choice when your table calls through LiveKit Cloud. Players' browsers download it from npm (jsDelivr) when they turn it on, and Krisp reports the room's name and id, the player's user id and how long it ran to your LiveKit Cloud project; see the README.
